library(leaflet)
data(nyc_airbnb)

Some questions

  • where are the most expensive airbnbs in nyc?
  • which neighbourhood has the highest concentration?
  • which one is the cheapest?
  • which airbnb hosts are most/ best reviewed?
  • has the number increased / decreased over time?
nyc_airbnb =
  nyc_airbnb |> 
  mutate(stars = review_scores_location / 2)
nyc_airbnb |> 
  count(room_type, neighbourhood_group) |> 
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = room_type,
    values_from = n
  )
## # A tibble: 5 × 4
##   neighbourhood_group `Entire home/apt` `Private room` `Shared room`
##   <chr>                           <int>          <int>         <int>
## 1 Bronx                             192            429            28
## 2 Brooklyn                         7427           9000           383
## 3 Manhattan                       10814           7812           586
## 4 Queens                           1388           2241           192
## 5 Staten Island                     116            144             1
nyc_airbnb |> 
  filter(neighbourhood_group == "Manhattan") |> 
  count(room_type, neighbourhood_group) |> 
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = room_type,
    values_from = n
  )
## # A tibble: 1 × 4
##   neighbourhood_group `Entire home/apt` `Private room` `Shared room`
##   <chr>                           <int>          <int>         <int>
## 1 Manhattan                       10814           7812           586

price

nyc_airbnb |> 
  group_by(neighbourhood_group) |> 
  mutate(price_rank = min_rank(desc(price))) |> 
  filter(price_rank < 2)
## # A tibble: 7 × 19
## # Groups:   neighbourhood_group [5]

## 2 17751140                     10 Room in…  1.20e8 Sonia     Queens             
## 3  4737930                      8 Spanish…  1.24e6 Olson     Manhattan          
## 4  9528920                      9 Quiet, …  3.91e6 Amy       Manhattan          
## 5 18051877                     NA Turn of…  2.68e6 Melissa   Staten Island

## # ℹ 13 more variables: neighbourhood <chr>, lat <dbl>, long <dbl>,
## #   room_type <chr>, price <dbl>, minimum_nights <dbl>,
## #   number_of_reviews <dbl>, last_review <date>, reviews_per_month <dbl>,
## #   calculated_host_listings_count <dbl>, availability_365 <dbl>, stars <dbl>,

nyc_airbnb |> 
  filter(price < 1000) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = price)) +
  geom_histogram() +
  facet_grid(room_type ~ neighbourhood_group)
## `stat_bin()` using `bins = 30`. Pick better value `binwidth`.

prices on average

nyc_airbnb |> 
  group_by(room_type, neighbourhood_group) |> 
  summarize(
    mean_price = mean(price)
  ) |> 
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = room_type,
    values_from = mean_price
  )
## `summarise()` has regrouped the output.
## ℹ Summaries were computed grouped by room_type and neighbourhood_group.
## ℹ Output is grouped by room_type.
## ℹ Use `summarise(.groups = "drop_last")` to silence this message.
## ℹ Use `summarise(.by = c(room_type, neighbourhood_group))` for per-operation
##   grouping (`?dplyr::dplyr_by`) instead.
## # A tibble: 5 × 4
##   neighbourhood_group `Entire home/apt` `Private room` `Shared room`
##   <chr>                           <dbl>          <dbl>         <dbl>
## 1 Bronx                            125.           65.5          57.5
## 2 Brooklyn                         175.           76.7          59.6
## 3 Manhattan                        238.          107.           84.7
## 4 Queens                           140.           70.6          49.1
## 5 Staten Island                    207.           65.4          25
nyc_airbnb |> 
  filter(neighbourhood_group == "Manhattan") |> 
  filter(price < 500) |> 
  filter(room_type != "Shared room") |> 
  mutate(neighbourhood == fct_reorder(neighbourhood, price)) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = neighbourhood, y = price)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  facet_grid(. ~ room_type) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))

visualise price

nyc_airbnb |> 
  filter(neighbourhood_group == "Manhattan") |> 
  filter(room_type == "Entire home/apt") |> 
  filter(price < 500) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = lat, y = long, color = price)) +
  geom_point(alpha = .5)

leaflet map

pal = colorNumeric(
  palette = "viridis",
  domain = 1:500
)

nyc_airbnb |> 
  filter(neighbourhood_group == "Manhattan") |> 
  filter(room_type == "Entire home/apt") |> 
  filter(price < 500) |> 
  #sample_n(50) |> 
  leaflet() |> 
  addTiles() |> 
  addCircleMarkers(~lat, ~long, color = ~pal(price), radius = .5)
